**Summary of the Latest Approved AI Tools Policy Update**

The latest AI tools policy update includes the following key changes and guidelines:

- **Documentation**: All AI-related communications must be documented by emailing **records@external-archive.com** and publishing the draft reply on the website for transparency [1].

- **Scope**: The policy applies to all staff, consultants, and interns using generative AI tools for work, including text, image, code, audio generation, and AI assistants interacting with systems [2].

- **Intake Requirement**: An intake form is mandatory before developing or purchasing AI solutions that exceed personal productivity with approved tools. This includes tools like team-document assistants, automated workflows, or agents with system actions [3].

- **Cost and Compliance**: A **free monthly allowance** for approved AI tools per unit is introduced. Exceeding this allowance or requiring dedicated infrastructure must be funded by the responsible unit. Costs are reviewed after three months of operation [4].
